messages:
helen (Design): quick design pass from me — a few behavior and copy things in the routing policies editor i noticed while testing the preview simulator. link to current figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/routing-editor
nate (PM): thanks! want to catch the priority ordering bugs first — heard reorder can flip rules unexpectedly after save?
kai (FE): yep saw that on staging. repro steps: drag rule 3 above rule 1, click save, UI shows new order but backend returns original order on next load. guess: optimistic UI + ordering key mismatch.
helen (Design): UX asks: should we keep optimistic ordering or lock until server confirms? i lean lock-with-spinner for accessibility/clarity — otherwise keyboard users get confused.
sofia (A11y): +1 lock approach. also keyboard reordering needs an accessible pattern: up/down move buttons with aria-live notifications ("Moved rule 3 to position 1"). current live region is missing.
kai (FE): can implement move buttons and aria-live, but that still leaves a11y gap for screen reader users when preview updates in place.
sofia (A11y): preview simulator updates should be announced. use role="status" and short messages like: "Preview updated: traffic routed to model-alpha." keep messages under 80 chars.
helen (Design): copy tweaks: replace "Priority" label with "Priority (higher = applied first)". this helps new users.
mika (QE): found validation hole: weights field allows floats but sum isn't validated client-side. backend rejects when >100 but UX shows vague toast: "Validation failed". we need inline error: "Total weight cannot exceed 100%" and highlight the sum row.
kai (FE): adding client-side check + red outline + error tooltip. suggestion for tooltip microcopy: "Weights total 105% — reduce values so total ≤ 100%."
helen (Design): microcopy for empty state in rules list: current placeholder "Add a rule" is ok but could be clearer: "No rules yet — add a routing rule to start routing traffic." small change but improves discoverability.
sofia (A11y): contrast nit: the disabled "Simulate" button at 16% contrast on light theme. needs to reach 3:1 per AA for UI components. prefer we use token `gray-600` instead of `gray-400` for disabled states.
helen (Design): preview sim UX: when switching from dev->prod models, the preview transitions instantly and users lose the current input. propose persist input across model switch and show subtle banner: "Input preserved while switching models" with dismiss.
nate (PM): product question: do we persist per-route or global preview input? i'd prefer per-route because teams test different prompts per policy.
helen (Design): agreed per-route. also add a small "reset input" affordance next to the banner.
kai (FE): implementation note: storing preview inputs in localStorage keyed by route_id will work for now. will add an expiration TTL 7 days.
sofia (A11y): keyboard focus flow: after saving reorder, focus should land on the moved rule, not the top of list. currently focus jumps to top — that's disorienting.
helen (Design): good call. also add visible focus ring for selected rule, + ensure focusable drag handles have aria-labels like "Grab to reorder rule: <rule name>".
mika (QE): regression to watch in tests: E2E for reorder, aria announcements, and client-side weight validation. i'll add tests in CI.
design-bot: new build deployed to staging with id: staging-2026-03-21-rc4 :rocket:
kai (FE): i'll push a PR for move buttons + client validation tonight. tagging @sofia for review on aria-live messages.
sofia (A11y): happy to review tomorrow morning. can we also add a short checklist in the PR description for screen reader QA?
helen (Design): final tiny copy: replace "Apply changes" button with "Save changes" and make hover state 2px darker to improve affordance. thanks y'all :heart:
nate (PM): prioritized: 1) lock-on-reorder + spinner, 2) aria announcements, 3) client-side weight check, 4) disabled contrast fix, 5) preview input persistence. meeting to sync at 11am.
